test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Feb, 2026 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In which year was the National Statistical Commission was constituted?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2006**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **National Statistical Commission (NSC)** of **India** was formally constituted on **12th July 2006**.
 
• The establishment of this body was based on the recommendations of the **Rangarajan Commission**, headed by **Dr. C. Rangarajan**, which submitted its report in **2001** to address the gaps in the Indian statistical system.
 
• The government issued a notification for the setting up of the commission on **1st June 2005**, leading to its actual constitution in the subsequent year.
 
• The **NSC** was designed to serve as an **autonomous body** responsible for evolving policies, priorities, and standards in statistical matters to ensure the credibility of official data.
 
• The first Chairman of the **National Statistical Commission** was the renowned economist **Professor Suresh Tendulkar**.
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is 2006**.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Organizational Structure**:

 
 
• The commission consists of a part-time **Chairperson**, four part-time **Members**, and an ex-officio member.
 
• The **CEO** of **NITI Aayog** (formerly the Planning Commission) serves as the ex-officio member.
 
• The **Chief Statistician of India (CSI)**, who is also the Secretary to the **Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)**, acts as the Secretary to the Commission.
 
 
 
• **Mandate and Functions**:
 
 
• The primary function of the **NSC** is to reduce the burden on data providers and improve the efficiency of the statistical system.
 
• It helps in standardizing **statistical concepts**, **definitions**, and **methodologies** used by various central and state government agencies.
 
• It exercises oversight over the **National Sample Survey Office (NSSO)** and the **Central Statistics Office (CSO)**.
 
 
 
• **MoSPI**:
 
 
• The **Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation** is the nodal agency for the planned development of the statistical system in the country.
 
• It ensures the timely release of key economic indicators like **GDP**, **CPI**, and **IIP**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **National Statistics Day**:

 
 
• In **India**, **June 29th** is celebrated as **National Statistics Day** every year.
 
• This day marks the birth anniversary of **Professor Prasanta Chandra Mahalanobis**, often referred to as the father of modern statistics in **India**, in recognition of his invaluable contribution in establishing the **National Statistical System**.
 
 
 
• **Merger of CSO and NSSO**:
 
 
• In **May 2019**, the **Government of India** approved the merger of the **Central Statistics Office (CSO)** and the **National Sample Survey Office (NSSO)** to create a unified **National Statistical Office (NSO)**.
 
• This restructuring was aimed at streamlining the data collection and processing activities under the umbrella of **MoSPI**.
 
 
 
• **Rangarajan Commission Report**:
 
 
• The commission was set up in **January 2000** and submitted its findings in **August 2001**. It highlighted that the lack of coordination and the absence of a legislative framework were major hurdles in the statistical system, leading to the creation of the **NSC**.
